proof_body:
by
  intro a x ha ha1 hx
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha1 with h | h
  · rw [Real.logb_pos_iff_of_base_lt_one ha h hx]
    constructor
    · intro h2
      exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (sub_neg.2 h) (sub_neg.2 h2)
    · intro h2
      by_contra hc
      have : 0 ≤ x - 1 := by linarith
      nlinarith
  · rw [Real.logb_pos_iff h hx]
    constructor
    · intro h2
      exact mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h) (sub_pos.2 h2)
    · intro h2
      by_contra hc
      have : x - 1 ≤ 0 := by linarith
      nlinarith
